target.title: Fix Codex fork identity and cache invalidation
target.body:
## Summary

- prefer `session_meta.payload.id` as the canonical Codex leaf-session identifier before parent-oriented `session_id` aliases
- persist the parent-session file fingerprint used for a fork baseline and invalidate a warm child cache entry whenever that parent appears or changes
- regenerate the Codex parser hash and add cold-scan plus warm-cache regression coverage

## Why

Newer Codex subagent logs can contain a unique child ID in `payload.id` while `payload.session_id` and `payload.forked_from_id` both point to the parent. Preferring `session_id` aliases multiple child files to the same parent identity.

There is also a separate warm-cache dependency problem: fork accounting depends on the parent snapshot at the fork timestamp, but cache freshness previously tracked only the child file. If the parent file was missing, discovered later, or appended after the child was cached, the stale child total could continue to include inherited usage.

This complements the existing fork-baseline and intra-file containment work by fixing cross-file identity and cache dependency invalidation. Refs #2037.

## Redacted local runtime proof

A local 578-file Codex JSONL corpus was frozen, then scanned with current `main` and this PR. Both builds read the exact same immutable input and used separate empty caches.

| Build and scan | Total tokens | `gpt-5.6-sol` | `gpt-5.6-terra` |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `main` cold | 3,366,585,874 | 3,251,017,362 | 115,568,512 |
| `main` warm | 3,366,585,874 | 3,251,017,362 | 115,568,512 |
| PR cold | 521,995,785 | 439,332,121 | 82,663,664 |
| PR warm 1 | 521,995,785 | 439,332,121 | 82,663,664 |
| PR warm 2 | 521,995,785 | 439,332,121 | 82,663,664 |

Under identical local input, this PR removes 2,844,590,089 tokens attributed by `main` (an 84.5% reduction). The PR result remains exactly stable at the aggregate/model level across the cold scan and both warm-cache scans.

Only aggregate token and model totals are included. Paths, session IDs, project names, account data, and other identifying metadata are omitted.

## Testing

- `swift test --filter 'CostUsageScannerBreakdownTests|CostUsageCacheTests'` — 89 tests passed
- `make check` — passed
- `./Scripts/compile_and_run.sh` — passed; release app built, signed, and launched
- GitHub macOS test shards, lint, aggregate gate, and Linux ARM64 build — passed
- Linux x64 reached an unrelated existing `PlatformGatingTests.claudeAutoPipeline_skipsUnsupportedWebAndUsesCLI` failure; the same PR passed the Linux ARM64 matrix and changes no Claude platform-gating code
- local `make test` also reached two unrelated `AdaptiveRefreshTimerTests` timing failures that reproduce in isolation; no timer code is changed here
